description: Defines data structures and APIs for managing memory domains and partitions in Zephyr OS, including memory domain initialization, partition addition/removal, and thread membership.

methods.name: k_mem_domain_init
methods.description: Initializes a memory domain with specified partitions.

methods.name: k_mem_domain_add_partition
methods.description: Adds a memory partition to a memory domain.

methods.name: k_mem_domain_remove_partition
methods.description: Removes a memory partition from a memory domain.

methods.name: k_mem_domain_add_thread
methods.description: Adds a thread to a memory domain.
